comments.text: Little fact related to John Lennon's death- In 2007 on the 9th of October, his widow, Yoko Ono erected an artwork in his name here in my home country, Iceland. It's known as Friðarsúlan, which translates to The Peace Tower. It's a symbol of the couple's fight for world peace, and it's fitting that it loves in the most peaceful country in the world. It's a beam of light, and on the pedestal, the words 'Imagine Peace' are engraved in 24 languages. I think it's something worth mentioning more, not only because it brings attention to my home country which gives me a strange sense of superiority over everyone else, but also because of what it symbolizes.
